about: Which projects' tasks Next actions leaves out unless includeOnHoldSomeday is on (D-20261031-02): a status as written in a project note, the status it reads as (null: the task has no project), and whether its tasks are parked. brainstead_core's projects::status_of and parks_tasks (the weekly review's preparation) and src/taskModel.ts's inParkedProject (the Tasks screen, the sidebar count, Weekly and the MCP tools) are each checked against this table.
